note: Template for the C25 owner-approved private execution manifest (docs/planning/evidence/C25/live-scope-request.md). Copy it OUTSIDE the repository, chmod 600, fill it and approve it. It fails validation until owner_approval is complete. Name secrets only by reference: {"kind": "keychain", "service": "io.cdot.prisma-airs-desktop.v2.<name>", "account": "..."} or {"kind": "file", "path": "/absolute/path/outside/the/repository"}. Environments are staging or test, never production. Check it with: cargo run -p xtask -- live-scope --scope <path>. Each family lists its non-secret field names (empty values) under nonsecret, and its credential names and budget keys in reason; every field is optional unless the check it feeds says it is blocked without it. Run it with: cargo run -p xtask -- live-run --scope <path> [--family Lxx].
